create.name: Mira Kelley
create.bio:
Mira Kelley is a past life regressionist, author and manifestation teacher whose interest in reincarnation began at thirteen, when she read Brian Weiss and tried a self-guided regression from a recorded script. As an adult she trained with Brian Weiss and with Dolores Cannon, and began guiding others through sessions that visit past, parallel and future lives and seek guidance from the Higher Self. Wayne Dyer wrote about a regression she led for him in Wishes Fulfilled, and her book Beyond Past Lives, published by Hay House with a foreword by Dyer, has since appeared in many languages.

Today most of her work happens online. She offers private sessions and group classes on Zoom, a regular podcast, and a large YouTube channel of guided regressions, hypnosis journeys, affirmations and talks about how past lives shape relationships, money and purpose. Her teaching leans towards the law of attraction as much as regression, with practices built around gratitude, self-worth and abundance, and she publishes guided journals for past life work, manifestation and couples. She also leads weekend programmes at Kripalu and speaks at conferences, often weaving stories from client sessions into her talks.

books.title: Beyond Past Lives: What Parallel Realities Can Teach Us about Relationships, Healing, and Transformation
books.author: Mira Kelley
books.description: Mira's best-known book draws on stories from her regression sessions to explore the idea that past, parallel and future lives are all happening at once. Each chapter ends with exercises for contacting your own Higher Self, and Wayne Dyer wrote the foreword.

books.title: Past Life Regression Journal: Integrate Your Past, Parallel and Future Life Experiences
books.author: Mira Kelley
books.description: A guided journal meant to sit alongside Beyond Past Lives, with prompts for recording and reflecting on what comes up during a regression. It includes access to a recorded regression led by Mira.

courses.title: Past Life Regression for Healing and Transformation
courses.description: A weekend at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, built around group regression sessions into past, parallel and future lives, with meditation, discussion and storytelling. It is open to newcomers and to people who have done regression before, and aims to connect participants with their Higher Self and their soul's lessons.

courses.title: Gratitude Creates Abundance
courses.description: A self-paced 21-day online challenge with a short audio meditation for each day, each one focused on a different area of abundance, followed by a journaling exercise. A recorded group call using tapping is included, and access does not expire.

free_resources.title: The Trust Meditation
free_resources.description: A free 20-minute guided meditation on trusting yourself, your life and Source, sent by email after a short sign-up. It can be used during the day to settle or at night to relax, and is offered in several languages.

free_resources.title: Who Were You in Your Past Life? Quiz
free_resources.description: A free seven-question online quiz that points to a past life archetype, such as protector or artist, and the lesson it may carry into this life. It links to longer articles on how earlier lives can shape the present.
